text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Classes have ended for the day at Lucent Academy.
Io and {0} are walking home.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルーセント学院での授業を終えたイオは、
{0}と一緒に下校していた。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: So, are you used to class now, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君、
授業には慣れた？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Remember, if you ever have trouble understanding something,
just ask me. I'll always be there to—
text_block_list.orig_text:
わからないことがあったら、何でも聞いてね。
私が答えて──

text_block_list.name: Girlfriend
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, c'mon!
I wanna get an ice cream cone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね～ね～
アタシ、
アイス食べた～い！

text_block_list.name: Boyfriend
text_block_list.text:
All right, all right.
We'll split one, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかたないなぁ。
半分こだからな？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oops, sorry!
I kinda spaced out there for a second.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ご、ごめんね！
つい、
ぼーっとしちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: I was just a little envious of that couple back there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきのカップル、
うらやましいなぁって。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I went to an all demonfolk girls school, so I've always
felt like I never got the full school experience.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
魔族の女子校に通っていたから、
学生生活を満喫できなかったのよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
When I think back on it, I wish I'd taken the opportunity
to have more fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いま思い返すと……
もっと学生生活を楽しんでおけばよかったわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I always loved the idea of things like grabbing a bite
after school, or going on dates with boys. I wish I could've
done some of those things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
学校帰りに買い食いしたり、
男の人とデートするのに、
あこがれてたのよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you mean? Are you saying you'll take me on
an after-school date?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
どういうこと？
私と放課後デートしてくれるの？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You know what? I think I'll take you up on that.
I'll even treat you to something to say thanks.
If there's anything in particular you're craving, say the word.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
お願いしようかな。
付き合ってくれるお礼に、
なにかご馳走してあげる。
食べたいものがあったら言ってね？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about that ice cream shop? They make ultra-premium
ice cream with really high milk-fat content. It's the richest,
tastiest ice cream around here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
あのアイスクリーム屋さん、
ミルクがとっても濃くて、
すごくおいしいのよ。
あそこでいい？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text: Great, I'll go buy us some.
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあ買ってくるわね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
I'm back!
Here's yours, {0}!
Hee hee hee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待たせ。
こっちが{0}君の分ね。
うふふ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? What is it?
I really look like I'm enjoying myself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
なに？
すごく楽しそう？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
You can tell, huh? Well, we [i]are[/i] grabbing a bite
after school, just like I always wanted!
text_block_list.orig_text:
気づかれちゃった？
だって、
これって放課後の買い食いよね？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, {0}.
You made one of my old dreams come true.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひとつ夢が叶っちゃった。
{0}君のおかげよ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
And this ice cream is a token of my appreciation.
Let's hurry and eat them before they mel—
text_block_list.orig_text:
このアイスは、
夢を叶えてくれたお礼ね。
早く食べようか。
急がないと溶けちゃ──

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Eeek!
C-cold!
Looks like mine's already melting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ！
つ、
つめたい……
アイス、
もう溶けちゃってるわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Nnnh!
It's dripping onto my chest!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
んんっ！
胸に、
アイスがたれて……！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Aww...
Now I'm going to be all sticky.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ……
これじゃあベトベトになっちゃう～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
{0}, can you mop me up?
Please, wipe this ice cream off before it runs down
into my clothes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}君、ふいてくれない？
お願い、
このままだと服の中まで入っちゃうわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
My hands are full holding both our cones.
I can't wipe it up myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
両手がアイスでふさがってて……
自分だとふけないの～！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Gladly?
I don't see what there is to be glad about, but...
Please.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よろこんで？
よくわからないけど……
お願いね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
That's the problem!
Please, hurry and wipe it off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから困るのよ。
いいから、早くふいて～

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hee... Hee hee!
That tickles. Ooh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ、
ふふ……！
くすぐったい……
あんっ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you all done?
Thanks a lot.
That would've made a big mess.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
ふき終わったの？
ありがとう、
助かったわ。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's try that again!
Here's your cone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
改めてアイスを食べましょ！
こっちが{0}君の分ね。

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
What's that? I could've handed you your cone, and cleaned
myself up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、なに？
アイスを渡せば、
自分でふけた？

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, that's true.
I guess I lost my head.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言われてみれば、
たしかに……
うっかりしてたわ。

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy 1
text_block_list.text: {0}, you little... Whattaya think you're doing?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}……
お、
お前、
なにやってんだ！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Hmm?
Oh, it's more friends from our class.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら？
あなたたちは私のクラスの……？

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy 2
text_block_list.text:
You dare put your hands on the m-m-magic orbs of our
beloved Io?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺たちのイオちゃんの
む、
む、
胸をっ！
許さん！

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy 1
text_block_list.text:
I sentence you to death!
Get him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
極刑だ！
あいつを捕まえろー！！

text_block_list.name: Schoolboy 2
text_block_list.text:
Don't let him get away!
After him!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃がすな！
追えー！！

text_block_list.name: Io
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha. Looks like {0}'s already made lots of friends!
I love to see healthy, growing boys horsing around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ、{0}君、
もうお友達ができたみたい！
男の子は元気でいいわね～
